content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. You told me two real things, a birthday with no phone and a morning that actually recharged you, and I rushed past both.

Happy birthday, truly. Walking the water with no phone after the stretch you've had sounds like exactly what you needed, not just a nice morning.

And telling your team you need a real break, after running on empty for months, that's not a small thing to say out loud. Two weeks starting Monday. I hope you actually unplug for it."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
